props.title: Aerospace-grade protection with meticulous care
props.subtitle: We combine industrial Fortador steam technology with Kevlar coatings and multi-stage paint correction right here in North Miami.

items.title: Kevlar Ceramic Protection
items.text: Cutting-edge ceramic coating infused with Kevlar particles for extreme hydrophobicity, gloss depth, and scratch resistance against intense Florida UV.

items.title: Fortador Steam Sanitization
items.text: High-temperature ecological steam extraction that penetrates deep into upholstery, killing 99.9% of bacteria, allergens, and mildew odors safely.

items.title: Multi-Stage Paint Correction
items.text: Precision rotary and dual-action machine polishing that permanently removes swirl marks, oxidation, and scratches to achieve a flawless mirror reflection.

items.title: Mobile & Shop Experience
items.text: Visit our Biscayne Boulevard facility or book our fully-equipped mobile detailing unit to your home or office anywhere across Miami.

props.title: Meticulous treatments tailored for your car
props.description: Every vehicle receives our undivided attention, hospital-grade sanitation, and long-lasting exterior shield.

services.title: Full Exterior Paint Correction & Wax
services.description: Hand wash, clay bar decontamination, 2-stage machine polish with premium @fortadorusa wax, wheel face & barrel deep cleaning, tire dressing.

services.title: Ceramic Kevlar Shield Coating
services.description: Multi-year hydrophobic barrier protecting paint against Florida sun, UV radiation, salt air, acid rain, and environmental fallout.

services.title: Total Steam Interior Deep Sanitization
services.description: Steam extraction of seats and carpets, premium leather conditioning, headliner cleaning, AC vents disinfection, and odor elimination.

services.title: Complete Concierge Detailing (In & Out)
services.description: The ultimate transformation: full paint enhancement polish + complete interior steam disinfection + engine bay detailing + paint sealant.
